verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a public MCP endpoint (/api/app/public/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP with just a URL and API key) plus a CLI with stable, additive `--json` output usable from any scriptable context including cron and coding agents, giving AI-native users two documented programmatic surfaces. missing for 10: no independent/third-party corroboration of the API's stability or real-world agent integration beyond first-party docs, and no formal OpenAPI/REST reference is shown alongside the MCP/CLI docs.
